newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MENOTTI EXPECTED AT SAMPDORIA NEXT MONTH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MENOTTI EXPECTED AT SAMPDORIA NEXT MONTH.

text.p: Argentine coach Cesar Luis Menotti is expected to join Sampdoria as soon as the Italian league soccer season ends next month, Italian sports daily Gazzetta Dello Sport reported on Tuesday.
Swede Sven Goran Eriksson is leaving the Genoa-based club to move to Lazio. The serie A season ends on June 1.

Menotti said last month that he had been talking to Sampdoria and media reports have suggested he wants to bring two players with him from his current Argentine club Independiente -- 24 year old defender Pablo Rochten and 23-year-old striker Angel "Matute" Morales.
The 59-year-old was Argentine national coach from 1974 to 1982, becoming a celebrity as the chain-smoking, pensive figure on the bench guiding Argentina to victory in the 1978 World Cup finals.

Menotti has never worked in Italy but has coached Newell's Old Boys, Boca Juniors and River Plate as well as his current club Independiente in his own country. He has also been coach at Barcelona and Atletico Madrid in Spain and Penarol in Uruguay.
